4 x DDR4 memory slots, support up to 128GB *ComboPI 1.0.0.3-based and above BIOS are required.

1st, 2nd and 3rd Gen AMD® Ryzen™ processors support x16, x8/x8 mode

Athlon™ with Radeon™ Vega Graphics processor supports x4/x0 speed

MM2_2 slot (from AMD X470 Chipset) supports PCIe 2.0x4 and SATA 6Gb/s 2242/2260/2280 storage devices2
SATA3 port will be unavailable when installing SATA M.2 SSD in M2_2 slot.
PCI_E5 slot will be unavailable when installing M.2 PCIe SSD in M2_2 slot.
